description: Manages DNS records using the Cloudflare API, see the docs: https://api.cloudflare.com/.

parameters.name: account_api_key
parameters.description: Account API key. Required for API keys authentication. You can obtain your API key from the bottom of the Cloudflare ‘My Account’ page, found here: https://dash.cloudflare.com/.

parameters.name: account_email
parameters.description: Account email. Required for API keys authentication.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Algorithm number. Required for type=DS and type=SSHFP when state=present.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: API token. Required for API token authentication. You can obtain your API token from the bottom of the Cloudflare ‘My Account’ page, found here: https://dash.cloudflare.com/. Can be specified in CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN environment variable since community.general 2.0.0.

parameters.name: cert_usage
parameters.description: Certificate usage number. Required for type=TLSA when state=present. Choices: 0 1 2 3

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Issuer Critical Flag. Should be set either to 0 for not critical, or to 128 for critical. Before community.general 12.3.0, only 0 and 1 were valid options. The value 1 is still available for backwards-compatibility reasons. Required for type=CAA when state=present. Choices: 0 1 128

parameters.name: hash_type
parameters.description: Hash type number. Required for type=DS, type=SSHFP and type=TLSA when state=present. Choices: 1 2

parameters.name: key_tag
parameters.description: DNSSEC key tag. Needed for type=DS when state=present.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Service port. Required for type=SRV and type=TLSA.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Record priority. Required for type=MX and type=SRV. Default: 1

parameters.name: proto
parameters.description: Service protocol. Required for type=SRV and type=TLSA. Common values are TCP and UDP.

parameters.name: proxied
parameters.description: Proxy through Cloudflare network or just use DNS. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: record
parameters.description: Record to add. Required if state=present. Default is @ (that is, the zone name). Default: "@"

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Selector number. Required for type=TLSA when state=present. Choices: 0 1

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Record service. Required for type=SRV.

parameters.name: solo
parameters.description: Whether the record should be the only one for that record type and record name. Only use with state=present. This deletes all other records with the same record name and type. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the record(s) should exist or not. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: CAA issue restriction. Required for type=CAA when state=present. Choices: "issue" "issuewild" "iodef"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Custom tags for the DNS record.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for Cloudflare API calls. Default: 30

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: The TTL to give the new record. Must be between 120 and 2,147,483,647 seconds, or 1 for automatic. Default: 1

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of DNS record to create. Required if state=present. Support for SPF has been removed from community.general 9.0.0 since that record type is no longer supported by CloudFlare. Support for PTR has been added in community.general 11.1.0. Choices: "A" "AAAA" "CNAME" "DS" "MX" "NS" "SRV" "SSHFP" "TLSA" "CAA" "TXT" "PTR"

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The record value. Required for state=present.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Service weight. Required for type=SRV. Default: 1

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The name of the Zone to work with (for example example.com). The Zone must already exist.

examples:
- name: Create a test.example.net A record to point to 127.0.0.1
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    record: test
    type: A
    value: 127.0.0.1
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
  register: record

- name: Create a record using api token
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    record: test
    type: A
    value: 127.0.0.1
    api_token: dummyapitoken

- name: Create a record with comment and tags
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    record: test
    type: A
    value: 127.0.0.1
    comment: Local test website
    tags:
      - test
      - local
    api_token: dummyapitoken

- name: Create a example.net CNAME record to example.com
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    type: CNAME
    value: example.com
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
    state: present

- name: Change its TTL
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    type: CNAME
    value: example.com
    ttl: 600
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
    state: present

- name: Delete the record
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    type: CNAME
    value: example.com
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
    state: absent

- name: Create a example.net CNAME record to example.com and proxy through Cloudflare's network
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.net
    type: CNAME
    value: example.com
    proxied: true
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
    state: present

# This deletes all other TXT records named "test.example.net"
- name: Create TXT record "test.example.net" with value "unique value"
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    domain: example.net
    record: test
    type: TXT
    value: unique value
    solo: true
    account_email: test@example.com
    account_api_key: dummyapitoken
    state: present

- name: Create an SRV record _foo._tcp.example.net
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    domain: example.net
    service: foo
    proto: tcp
    port: 3500
    priority: 10
    weight: 20
    type: SRV
    value: fooserver.example.net

- name: Create a SSHFP record login.example.com
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.com
    record: login
    type: SSHFP
    algorithm: 4
    hash_type: 2
    value: 9dc1d6742696d2f51ca1f1a78b3d16a840f7d111eb9454239e70db31363f33e1

- name: Create a TLSA record _25._tcp.mail.example.com
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.com
    record: mail
    port: 25
    proto: tcp
    type: TLSA
    cert_usage: 3
    selector: 1
    hash_type: 1
    value: 6b76d034492b493e15a7376fccd08e63befdad0edab8e442562f532338364bf3

- name: Create a CAA record subdomain.example.com
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.com
    record: subdomain
    type: CAA
    flag: 0
    tag: issue
    value: ca.example.com

- name: Create a DS record for subdomain.example.com
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: example.com
    record: subdomain
    type: DS
    key_tag: 5464
    algorithm: 8
    hash_type: 2
    value: B4EB5AC4467D2DFB3BAF9FB9961DC1B6FED54A58CDFAA3E465081EC86F89BFAB

- name: Create PTR record "1.2.0.192.in-addr.arpa" with value "test.example.com"
  community.general.cloudflare_dns:
    zone: 2.0.192.in-addr.arpa
    record: 1
    type: PTR
    value: test.example.com
    state: present

return_values.name: record
return_values.description: A dictionary containing the record data. Returned: success, except on record deletion

return_values.name: comment
return_values.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record. Returned: success Sample: "Domain verification record"

return_values.name: comment_modified_on
return_values.description: When the record comment was last modified. Omitted if there is no comment. Returned: success Sample: "2024-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z"

return_values.name: content
return_values.description: The record content (details depend on record type). Returned: success Sample: "192.0.2.91"

return_values.name: created_on
return_values.description: The record creation date. Returned: success Sample: "2016-03-25T19:09:42.516553Z"

return_values.name: data
return_values.description: Additional record data. Returned: success, if type is SRV, DS, SSHFP TLSA or CAA Sample: {"name": "jabber", "port": 8080, "priority": 10, "proto": "_tcp", "service": "_xmpp", "target": "jabberhost.sample.com", "weight": 5}

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: The record ID. Returned: success Sample: "f9efb0549e96abcb750de63b38c9576e"

return_values.name: locked
return_values.description: No documentation available. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: meta
return_values.description: Extra Cloudflare-specific information about the record. Returned: success Sample: {"auto_added": false}

return_values.name: modified_on
return_values.description: Record modification date. Returned: success Sample: "2016-03-25T19:09:42.516553Z"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The record name as FQDN (including _service and _proto for SRV). Returned: success Sample: "www.sample.com"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: Priority of the MX record. Returned: success, if type is MX Sample: 10

return_values.name: proxiable
return_values.description: Whether this record can be proxied through Cloudflare. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: proxied
return_values.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Custom tags for the DNS record. Returned: success Sample: ["production", "app"]

return_values.name: tags_modified_on
return_values.description: When the record tags were last modified. Omitted if there are no tags. Returned: success Sample: "2025-01-01T05:20:00.12345Z"

return_values.name: ttl
return_values.description: The time-to-live for the record. Returned: success Sample: 300

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The record type. Returned: success Sample: "A"

return_values.name: zone_id
return_values.description: The ID of the zone containing the record. Returned: success Sample: "abcede0bf9f0066f94029d2e6b73856a"

return_values.name: zone_name
return_values.description: The name of the zone containing the record. Returned: success Sample: "sample.com"
